prompt: Catch the last train: get your ticket and reach the platform before it leaves

intent.setting: a bustling multi-level train station at dusk
intent.role: a commuter who must catch the last train
intent.goal: obtain a ticket from the booth and reach the platform before the train begins to depart
intent.fail: the train leaves without you, or you run out of time before reaching the platform
intent.headline: Booth→platform route is the only way to make the train's departure timer
